description.raw: '''Passive:''' Enemies hit by ''[[File:Anivia Flash Frost.png|20xpx|border|link=Anivia#Flash Frost|An icon for Anivia's ability Flash Frost]] [[Anivia#Flash Frost|Flash Frost]]'' or a fully formed ''[[File:Anivia Glacial Storm.png|20xpx|border|link=Anivia#Glacial Storm|An icon for Anivia's ability Glacial Storm]] [[Anivia#Glacial Storm|Glacial Storm]]'' become ''Chilled'' for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.
description.text: Passive: Enemies hit by Flash Frost or a fully formed Glacial Storm become Chilled for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Anivia''' blasts a freezing wind at the target enemy that deals magic damage, [[File:Successfully enhanced damage magic icon.png|20px|link=Damage#Successful_ability_casts]] doubled if they were ''Chilled''.
description2.text: Active: Anivia blasts a freezing wind at the target enemy that deals magic damage, doubled if they were Chilled.

notes.raw: * The damage of ''Frostbite'' is calculated once it hits. If the target's mark from being hit by [[File:Anivia Flash Frost.png|20xpx|border|link=Anivia#Flash Frost|An icon for Anivia's ability Flash Frost]] [[Anivia#Flash Frost|Flash Frost]] or a fully formed [[File:Anivia Glacial Storm.png|20xpx|border|link=Anivia#Glacial Storm|An icon for Anivia's ability Glacial Storm]] [[Anivia#Glacial Storm|Glacial Storm]] wears off while the projectile is traveling, the damage is not doubled. * ''Frostbite'' has a different sound effect when it hits a target for double damage. * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away or no longer in [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
notes.text:
The damage of Frostbite is calculated once it hits. If the target's mark from being hit by Flash Frost or a fully formed Glacial Storm wears off while the projectile is traveling, the damage is not doubled.
Frostbite has a different sound effect when it hits a target for double damage.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on  cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
